decisions.thought: 74% MOVE: dragondance, 9% MOVE: shadowball, 5% SWITCH: garchomp

Opponent lead is Dragapult (Dragon/Ghost, outspeeds us). Fake Out is useless into it (Ghost immune to Normal). Dragapult's Atk is already at -1. Plan: Parting Shot to lower its Atk and Sp. Atk and bring in Corviknight, which resists Dragon and handles Dragapult. Watch for Scizor, Garchomp and Gholdengo (Good as Gold). Keep Incineroar's Intimidate and Fake Out for later leads.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Right, Dragapult is Dragon/Ghost so Fake Out won't land since it's immune to Normal moves. I should consider Protect to scout instead, or just go for an attacking move like Flare Blitz since Dragapult likely outspeeds anyway.

Actually, Parting Shot seems like the better call—it drops Dragapult's attack and special attack while pivoting safely into Corviknight, who resists Dragon Darts and takes Shadow Ball neutrally thanks to its Steel typing. That's the stronger play.

decisions.thought: Dragapult (Dragon/Ghost) has Dragon Dance up: Atk -1 net, SpA -1, Spe +1, and it outspeeds Incineroar. Fake Out is useless into Ghost. Switching to Corviknight: it has high bulk, Mirror Armor, Roost, and U-turn to pivot out. Plan to wear Dragapult down with Roost/U-turn, then bring Gholdengo's Shadow Ball (Ghost, super effective) to finish it. Watch for Garchomp, Scizor, Gholdengo (Good as Gold), Greninja, and Palafin.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Dragapult's stats are now net -1 attack, -1 special attack, +1 speed after the exchange of moves, so it's gained a speed edge but lost offensive power. I'm weighing whether to switch to Corviknight, which resists Dragon and could handle this weakened Dragapult well.

Checking Gholdengo against Dragapult, Shadow Ball would hit for solid damage but Dragapult's speed with Dragon Dance edges it out too fast. Corviknight feels safer here - it can soak hits, Roost off damage, and its Mirror Armor punishes stat-drop effects, so I'll bring in Corviknight.

decisions.hidden_reasoning:
I'm tracking Dragapult's stat changes - the intimidate and Dragon Dance canceled out, then Parting Shot dropped attack and special attack by one stage while speed went up, leaving it at -1 atk, -1 spa, +1 spe. Now I'm comparing speeds: Dragapult boosted is well above Corviknight's 87.

I'm leaning toward Brave Bird for recoil-fueled Shell Bell recovery, with Roost as the safer alternative to stay topped off, while also considering U-turn to pivot out.
